part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in packages/babel-generator/src/source-map.ts:99 — when `inputSourceMap` has no `sourcesContent` field, `TraceMap.sourcesContent` is `undefined`, so `sourcesContent[i]` threw `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')`.

The fix guards the lookup with optional chaining (`sourcesContent?.[i]`), so `setSourceContent` receives `undefined` content instead of crashing.

Verification:
- The previously failing test `inputSourceMap without sourcesContent` (packages/babel-generator/test/index.js:884) now passes, matching its inline snapshot (`sourcesContent: [undefined]`).
- Full `@babel/generator` suite: 591 passed.
- Full `@babel/core` suite: 452 passed.
- End-to-end `transformSync` with an `inputSourceMap` lacking `sourcesContent` no longer throws.
